fetch.description: Generic URL fetch. Requires uvx (uv) on PATH. No token.

args: s=$1; shift; d=$PWD; until [ -f "$d/$s" ] || [ "$d" = / ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -f "$d/$s" ] || { echo "mcp-launcher: no $s in $PWD or any parent folder" >&2; exit 1; }; exec bash "$d/$s" "$@"
github.description: GitHub MCP server. Launcher self-loads GITHUB_TOKEN from root .env when the shell that launched the client didn't export it (no direnv here), mirroring run-openthrottle-mcp.sh. No env block: an unexpanded ${GITHUB_TOKEN} placeholder is what triggers the client's 'Failed to replace env in config' warning, and the launcher handles both exported and .env token sources. The args walk up from the client's cwd to the folder holding the launcher, because clients find this config by walking up but spawn the server with their own cwd: a session opened in a subdirectory or a nested repo (services/*) could not find a ./scripts path. The walk uses no ${} so no client tries to expand it.

openthrottle-mcp.description: OpenThrottle (OT) plans knowledge base (Postgres + GraphQL). Plans, tasks, notes, commit links, activity, output stream, semantic search, health. No env block, for the same reason as the github entry: an unexpanded ${VAR} placeholder is what triggers the client's 'Missing environment variables' / 'Failed to replace env in config' warning, and the launcher already owns resolution. API_URL and API_URL_INTERNAL would be discarded regardless (the launcher probes for a live server and exports both itself); ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is read nowhere in openthrottle-mcp; and OPENTHROTTLE_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN is inherited from the launching shell when exported, else self-loaded from this worktree's .env or the root checkout's. The args walk up from the client's cwd to the folder holding the launcher, because clients find this config by walking up but spawn the server with their own cwd: a session opened in a subdirectory or a nested repo (services/*) could not find a ./scripts path. The walk uses no ${} so no client tries to expand it.
